presentation.summary: Sign in to Silo with any OpenID Connect identity provider.
presentation.description_markdown: A generic, vendor-agnostic OpenID Connect auth provider for Silo. Works against any identity provider that publishes `.well-known/openid-configuration` — Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, Zitadel, Pocket ID, Auth0, and others. Reference example for the `auth_provider.v1` capability's OAuth flow.
presentation.setup_markdown: Set **Issuer URL**, **Client ID**, and **Client Secret** (if your IdP requires one) from your OpenID Connect provider's application registration, then enable **OpenID Connect** as a login method.

capabilities.description: Generic OIDC authorization-code login backed by any provider's discovery document.

global_config_schema.title: OpenID Connect settings
global_config_schema.description: Connection details for the identity provider this installation authenticates against.

fields.label: Issuer URL
fields.description: Base URL of the identity provider. Discovery is fetched from {issuer_url}/.well-known/openid-configuration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: Leave blank for a public client.

fields.label: Scopes
fields.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes. "openid" is always included.

fields.label: Username claim
fields.description: ID token / userinfo claim used as the Silo username on auto-provisioning.

fields.label: Require PKCE
fields.description: Use PKCE (S256) on the authorization-code flow. Disable only for providers that reject it.

fields.label: Allowed groups
fields.description: Comma-separated list of groups. Restricts login to users whose groups claim intersects this list. Empty allows all authenticated users.
